displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump or 24VNA9 air conditioner. Short flashes, then long flashes. Code 55 is 5 short flashes and 5 long flashes
causes: Sensor harness not connected to the AOC control
Coil thermistor not properly attached, or attached in the wrong location
Hardware damage to the AOC control
diySteps: If the outdoor coil thermistor fails, the manual says defrost occurs at each time interval during heating, and ends after 2 minutes
Technician: make sure the sensor is clipped to the distributor entry tube, check the harness, and replace the AOC only if its hardware is damaged
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 55 is flashing. Short defrost cycles in cold weather can be this sensor, not an empty refrigerant charge.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
